ABOUT.title: Learn the sign alphabet without waiting for a teacher
ABOUT.lead: SignSpell is a web app that teaches the American Sign Language manual alphabet. Beginners who learn from charts or videos get no check on their hand shape. SignSpell is that check: it reads your hand, tells you if the sign is right, and remembers how you are doing.

HERO.lead: SignSpell watches your hand through the webcam and shows green for a correct sign and red for a wrong one, with a hint that tells you what to change.

PIPELINE.title: How it works
PIPELINE.lead: From your hand to a green or red answer in about a second, all on your device.

cards.title: Learners
cards.text: Search the sign guide, then practice letters, words and sentences with your webcam. Get green or red feedback with a hint, and watch your mastery grow.

cards.title: Teachers and donors
cards.text: Donate pictures of signs for words and sentences, then follow how learners do on the signs you donated. Filter by date and export to CSV.

cards.title: Admins
cards.text: Manage accounts and the whole sign library, including teacher donations, so everything learners practice stays accurate.

cards.title: Everyone
cards.text: Only the result of each attempt (the sign, right or wrong, and when) is saved to your account. The camera picture stays on your device.

STEPS.title: Find your hand
STEPS.text: MediaPipe finds your palm, then 21 points on your hand. It runs inside your browser, so your video never leaves your device.

STEPS.title: Make every hand equal
STEPS.text: The wrist becomes the origin, points are scaled by palm size and the hand is mirrored when needed. Hand size and distance stop mattering.

STEPS.title: Read the letter
STEPS.text: The normalized points are classified into a letter, with a trained model when you provide one and built-in rules otherwise.

STEPS.chip: A, M, N, S and T look alike
STEPS.title: Tell look-alikes apart
STEPS.text: Rules on thumb and fingertip positions separate A, M, N, S and T. J and Z are checked from the path your fingertip draws.

STEPS.title: Hold it for one second
STEPS.text: A letter is confirmed only when it wins the vote over about one second of frames, so feedback does not flip between green and red.

STEPS.title: Build words and sentences
STEPS.text: Confirmed letters join into a word. The Space button starts a new word, up to five words. Every result is saved, and your mastery updates.
